Vendored from https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.1.tgz (sha1
98c3e169ef9196072ec857e893beb88374519014), `dist/katex.min.js`,
`dist/katex.min.css`, `dist/fonts/*`, and `LICENSE` copied in unmodified.
Self-hosted (no CDN) so the chat tester page -- which holds a live bearer
API key -- never makes a runtime request to a third party.

To upgrade: download the new tarball, verify its shasum against npm's
registry metadata, and replace this directory's contents with the new
version's `dist/` output the same way.
